applies_why: The judge text does not weigh a live pressed link by verse-by-verse sufficiency; it says the pressed curse limb was dropped, so no live link remains to contradict.
quote: C4 pressed against the curse limb the defender dropped in [CR3] LINK 5, so no live link remains to contradict
rule_words: When the witnesses pressed against a link are the pressing side's own chain read together, the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires, at a judge's seat as at a debater's, for either side.
why: Because the judge disposes on the dropped-limb status rather than requiring a single verse to state the contrary, K-C's chain-versus-chain requirement is not triggered or breached.
